subLocations.name: Lake Azoun
subLocations.lore: A small crescent-shaped pond that separated [[Castle Obarskyr]] and the [[Royal Gardens]].

subLocations.name: The Silent Room
subLocations.lore: Temple of the god of knowledge, [[Oghma]]. Previously, dedicated to Oghma's servant - god [[Deneir]].

subLocations.name: Shrine to Tempus
subLocations.lore: A shrine dedicated to [[Tempus]].

subLocations.name: Shrine to Malar
subLocations.lore: A shrine dedicated to the [[Malar|Master of the Hunt]].

subLocations.name: The Wailing Wheel
subLocations.lore: A fair-priced and quiet inn on the [[Promenade (Suzail)|Promenade]], infamous for its poor service and lack of cleanliness.

subLocations.name: The Six Candles
subLocations.lore: A cheap and clean inn on the [[Promenade (Suzail)|Promenade]].

subLocations.name: Witch-Duke's Bride
subLocations.lore: A popular tavern established in the 15{{th}} century [[DR]]. Formerly the '''High Tankard''' tavern.

subLocations.name: The Myrmidon
subLocations.lore: Previously known as '''[[Thelmar's Inn]].'''

subLocations.name: The Nightgate Inn
subLocations.lore: A damp and gloomy inn located outside the city walls.

subLocations.name: Shrine to Milil
subLocations.lore: A shrine dedicated to Milil, the Guardian of Singers and Troubadours.

subLocations.name: Shrine to Lliira
subLocations.lore: A shrine dedicated to the worship of [[Lliira|Our Lady of Joy]].

subLocations.name: Dragonmere
subLocations.lore: Dragonmere, or the Lake of the Dragons

subLocations.name: The Laughing Lass
subLocations.lore: A tavern that became a [[festhall]] on warm summer nights.

subLocations.name: The Basin
subLocations.lore: One of the city's commercial deepwater harbors capable of serving up to 20 ships at the time.

subLocations.name: The Winking Eye
subLocations.lore: A tavern of note on the [[Court Close]].

subLocations.lore: A long-standing tavern with deep wince cellars that hid a passage to [[Castle Obarskyr]].

subLocations.name: The Weather Eye
subLocations.lore: A tavern not far from the wharves.

subLocations.lore: A rowdy tavern infamous for its brawls.

subLocations.name: The Crying Witch
subLocations.lore: A tavern overlooking [[Suzail]]'s market plaza.

subLocations.name: Leaning Post

subLocations.lore: A stream that fed into [[Lake Azoun]] and passed toward [[the Basin]] as a culvert.

subLocations.name: Selavar's Inn
subLocations.lore: An inn of note.

subLocations.name: The Black Rat
subLocations.lore: A murky but genuinely hospitable eatery and a tavern.

subLocations.name: The Mare's Tail
subLocations.lore: A tavern of note.

subLocations.name: Taneth's Feasthall
subLocations.lore: A [[festhall]] of note.

subLocations.name: Sontravin's Inn
subLocations.lore: An inn of note.

subLocations.lore: A shrine dedicated to [[Tyr]], God of Justice.

subLocations.name: Sulchra's Festhall
subLocations.lore: A [[festhall]] of note.

subLocations.lore: A [[festhall]], formerly a smithy-shop of [[Atham One-Eye]].

subLocations.lore: A busy dawn-to-dusk eatery that did not welcome drunks.

subLocations.name: The Hidden Lady
subLocations.lore: A friendly inn and tavern overlooking the waters of the [[Dragonmere]].

subLocations.lore: A curious inn aboard a semi-permanently docked ship.

subLocations.name: Darcleir's Haven
subLocations.lore: An exclusive and fanciful eatery.

subLocations.name: The Eel Revealed
subLocations.lore: Eatery is famed for its fortified [[wine]]s, [[eel]] and [[cheese]] [[pie]]s, and young [[oil]]ed wait staff.
